memory_update.text: DSGX should be tracked as the primary underfollowed public-market mapping for tariff/customs compliance infrastructure because it combines customs workflow software, trade-content databases, classification tools, and logistics networks.

ULS is a larger but unusually pure TIC/compliance infrastructure candidate; verify whether regulatory/product-compliance demand is tied to domestic-content, infrastructure procurement, or tariff-induced supply-chain shifts.
TRI is best used as a reference leader for enterprise global trade management through ONESOURCE rather than as the main underfollowed alpha candidate.
NOTE has explicit tariff-tracker exposure but is a micro-cap speculative shadow candidate requiring listing, liquidity, dilution, and ARR-materiality verification before any later-layer survival.

Private or non-US-primary-listed firms dominate many pure-play lanes: Altana, Avalara, Assent, Sourcemap, former E2open assets now inside WiseTech, Intertek, SGS, Bureau Veritas, and QIMA. Future passes should map listed parents/ADRs only if the dashboard permits OTC or non-US primary listings.

node: Tariff, customs, domestic-content, and supply-chain compliance infrastructure
summary: Expanded the universe around the hypothesis that tariff volatility, Buy American / domestic-content rules, forced-labor enforcement, export controls, and customs complexity create second-order demand for compliance infrastructure rather than only for tariff-protected manufacturers. The strongest US-listed underfollowed mapping is Descartes Systems Group for customs/regulatory software and trade-content data. UL Solutions is a larger but unusually pure TIC/software-advisory name tied to product compliance and global market access. Thomson Reuters is included as a reference leader because ONESOURCE is a visible enterprise global trade compliance platform. FiscalNote is a speculative micro-cap exception because it has an explicit tariff-tracker/regulatory-intelligence product, but market-cap and financial-quality risks make it a Layer 1 hypothesis only.
